Lemma

1. ch1:1.13Let $\mathcal X$ be a locally finite family of subsets of a topological space $M$. Then $\{ \overline X:X\in \mathcal X\} $ is locally finite and \[ \overline{\bigcup _{X\in \mathcal X}X} =\bigcup _{X\in \mathcal X}\overline X. \]
